step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard diagram shows an IoT asset tracking architecture for gym equipment (Ecofit). Sensors on fitness equipment connect to a gateway running AWS IoT Greengrass. Greengrass streams data along two paths: 1) Real-time sensor health telemetry to AWS IoT Core, which queues messages in SQS, triggers a Sensor Health Lambda, and sends alerts via SNS. 2) Equipment utilization data sent via API Gateway to a Utilization Lambda, and stored in a TimeSeries DB (Timestream). An App connects to API Gateway for installation/configuration and receives real-time information back from Greengrass. A Reporting Lambda reads from the TimeSeries DB to generate automated customer reports. Isolated/unconnected icons on the board include Cognito, a top SQS queue, and a second API Gateway.

edges.notes: Equipment sensors send data to local Greengrass gateway
Greengrass provides real-time information directly to mobile installer app
Mobile app interacts with backend via API Gateway
Greengrass routes utilization data to API Gateway
API Gateway triggers Utilization Lambda to process metrics
Greengrass sends real-time sensor health telemetry to IoT Core
IoT Core updates sensor health data into SQS queue
SQS queue delivers health events to Sensor Health Lambda
Sensor Health Lambda triggers SNS alerts if gateway/sensor is down
Reporting Lambda consumes data from TimeSeries DB to build automated reports
